description: Sent to a student a couple of days before a borrowed library item is due back, so they can return or renew it in time. Triggered by the due-soon notification sweep.
subject: Due soon: {{book_title}} (back by {{due_date}})
body:
Hi {{first_name}},

This is a friendly reminder that the following library item is due back soon:

  Item:     {{book_title}}
  Due date: {{due_date}}

What to do
----------
  - Bring it back to the library desk by the due date, or
  - Renew it in the sixth-form portal (or at the desk) if no one else is waiting for it.

Returning on time keeps the shelves stocked for everyone and avoids overdue charges.

{{system_name}} Library
